description: This Java class implements an immutable version of the RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand interface, serving as a specific command for retrieving attributes in a live query context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates a JsonPointer indicating the attribute to retrieve and provides methods for creating instances, setting headers, and generating responses.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand that encapsulates a JsonPointer for the attribute to retrieve and extends AbstractQueryLiveCommand for live querying capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImpl based on a given Command, casting it to RetrieveAttribute.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer indicating the attribute to be retrieved.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with the specified DittoHeaders set.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Generates a new RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder for constructing responses.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object, including class name and superclass details.
